name: robintech
description: RobinTech agent toolkit — engineering skills and product tooling for coding agents.

plugins.name: robin-cloud-onboarding
plugins.description: Onboard your project to Robin-Cloud end-to-end with an AI agent — analyze the repo, generate Dockerfiles + a keyless CI workflow + nginx, then drive the console setup (GitHub App, ECR, deploy config, DB, custom domain + TLS) with verified checkpoints. No cluster access needed.

plugins.name: arch-explorer
plugins.description: Build an interactive, recursively drillable architecture map of a codebase as a single self-contained HTML file — boxes are modules, labeled arrows are the interfaces between them, and every arrow expands to full signatures with source locations. Open it with a chat panel that answers questions from the code-wiki via headless Claude or Codex. Also maps what a branch changed against main, block by block, and opens that map with a chat that answers from the session that built it.

plugins.name: code-wiki
plugins.description: Build and maintain a hierarchical, LLM-generated wiki over a codebase — leaf folders summarize their files, parents synthesize their children, topic pages capture cross-cutting concerns, and sync keeps it current with the source tree.

plugins.name: grounded
plugins.description: Deep opinions from the strongest model, fact-checked by a cheaper one in a separate context. `ask` switches to Fable and writes the opinion as a document you keep discussing; `verify` hands only that document to a read-only Sonnet verifier that extracts the factual claims it rests on and confirms, refutes or marks each unverifiable with cited evidence — then Fable re-judges every refutation against the citations, revises the document, and a fresh verifier checks the revision — up to three rounds, with repeat refutations escalated to you.

plugins.name: mvp-builder
plugins.description: 아이디어 한 줄에서 MVP까지 — 스펙 → 승인 → 설계·리뷰 루프 → 승인 → 구현. 발견 원장 기반 델타 리뷰, 기계 게이트, 내장 agent-skills(full) 또는 가벼운 기본 프롬프트(--lite). Idea to MVP: spec → approval → design/review loops → approval → build, with ledger-based delta review and machine gates.
